title: The Most Curious Cloud on Mars Relies on Some Bizarre Physics - Nautilus
gist: Nautilus describes the Arsia Mons Elongated Cloud (AMEC) on Mars, which forms at dawn in the spring/summer dusty season as air pushed up the volcano's flanks freezes scant water vapor, then streams across the sky on winds up to 373 mph.
